subject: modeling group fixed effects, almost perfect correlation in pairs plot

messages.author: e19ea506112fd25b
messages.subject: modeling group fixed effects, almost perfect correlation in pairs plot
parts:
Hi,

Could anyone help with modeling group fixed effects? There are two groups of individuals. One group is described by parameter kid_vmax_1, another group is described by kid_vmax_2, both are non negative. Is the following stan code correct or there is a better practice?
model{
  for(n in 1:N)
    y[n]~normal(mu[n],sigma);
}
transformed parameters{
  real<lower=0>theta[2];

  for(n in 1:N)
    mu[n]=function(theta[group[n]);
  for(i in 1 : 2)
    theta[i]=(group_fixed_effect*group[i]+1)*kid_vmax; // group is 0 or 1
}
parameters{
  real<lower=0>kid_vmax;
  real group_fixed_effect;
  real<lower=0>sigma;
}

The next question is re-parametrization when pairs shows almost perfect correlation. Specific example is Michaelis–Menten equation for kidney - it has two parameters kid_vmax and kid_km. After plotting logs of kid_vmax and kid_km I am getting almost perfect line. Can I re-parametrize log(kid_vmax)=a+b*log(kid_km)?

Thanks for any advice,
Linas
